title: Farrer Park Hospital Crawler
description: Web crawler for extracting specialist doctor information from Farrer Park Hospital website. Crawls all pages automatically.

headless.title: 🖥️ Headless Mode
headless.description: Run browser in headless mode. Set to false for debugging, true for production.

outputFilename.title: 📁 Output Filename (Optional)
outputFilename.description: Custom filename for the output JSON file (without .json extension). If not provided, will use default naming.

proxyConfiguration.title: 🌐 Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Configure proxy settings for web scraping. Leave empty to disable proxy usage.

enabled.title: Enable Proxy
enabled.description: Enable proxy usage for web scraping

proxies.title: Proxy List
proxies.description: List of proxy servers to use for rotation

host.title: Host
host.description: Proxy server hostname or IP address

maxFailures.title: Max Failures per Proxy
maxFailures.description: Maximum number of failures before marking proxy as failed
